description: Validate a Wompi event signature. Accepts either the properties-based checksum (SHA-256 of ordered props + timestamp + WOMPI_EVENTS_SECRET) or a raw-body HMAC-SHA256 signature.

checksum.description: Expected checksum from event payload (properties mode)

properties.description: Ordered list of property values concatenated before hashing (properties mode)

raw_body.description: Raw JSON body of the event (hmac mode)

secret.description: Override secret; defaults to WOMPI_EVENTS_SECRET env

name: validate_webhook_signature
